CouchDB is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2015.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Web](@/projects/web.md) (1).

Most recently: [microscratch](@/work/microscratch.md): Light Weight Web Framework using node.js, mongo, sockets, ember.js; [microcrawler-couchapp](@/work/microcrawler-couchapp.md): Microcrawler Web UI for browsing results (couchapp).

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses CouchDB: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links CouchDB to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
